sections.Profile:
The Cover Girl pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1962, was designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. This single-player electro-mechanical (EM) machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and two gobble holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1962
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Fashion, Wedgehead, Original Theme
